items.title: Welcome to Ming’s Restaurant
items.text: The absolute best Chinese food in the hatboro/willow grove area! The EGG ROLLS are the best I've ever had, I cannot recommend mings enough!! The service is incredible and it's great for vegans/vegetarians!
